summary: Filing is a Form 8-K reporting the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share on common stock, payable June 17, 2026 to holders of record June 3, 2026. The dividend is a routine capital return to shareholders, with no special-situation characteristics such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or strategic review. The board approved the dividend as part of ordinary course operations. No deal terms apply beyond the per-share amount. This is purely a standard dividend announcement and does not qualify as a special situation under the requested categories.
